papers.title: Inferring solutions of differential equations using noisy multi-fidelity data
papers.abstract: For more than two centuries, solutions of differential equations have been obtained either analytically or numerically based on typically well-behaved forcing and boundary conditions for well-posed problems. We are changing this paradigm in a fundamental way by establishing an interface between probabilistic machine learning and differential equations. We develop data-driven algorithms for general linear equations using Gaussian process priors tailored to the corresponding integro-differential operators. The only observables are scarce noisy multi-fidelity data for the forcing and solution that are not required to reside on the domain boundary. The resulting predictive posterior distributions quantify uncertainty and naturally lead to adaptive solution refinement via active learning. This general framework circumvents the tyranny of numerical discretization as well as the consistency and stability issues of time-integration, and is scalable to high-dimensions.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该方法使用高斯过程求解微分方程，具有不确定性量化，可迁移到生物力学中的代理建模。
llm.why_not_core: Does not handle constraints specific to implant design, no application to biomechanics or implant-related PDEs.

summary_zh.motivation: 用带噪声的多保真度数据推断微分方程解
summary_zh.method: 基于高斯过程先验结合积分微分算子
summary_zh.result: 实现不确定性量化与自适应求解改进

summary_en.motivation: Develop a data-driven framework to infer solutions of differential equations from noisy multi-fidelity observations.
summary_en.method: Employ Gaussian process priors tailored to integro-differential operators to model the solution.
summary_en.result: The predictive posterior distributions quantify uncertainty and enable adaptive refinement.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmark problems of linear differential equations.

papers.title: Superior creep strength of a nickel-based superalloy produced by selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Materials Science & Engineering Institute I, Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg, Martensstraße 5, D-91058 Erlangen, Germany

corresponding_authors.name: M. Pröbstle
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Materials Science & Engineering Institute I, Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg, Martensstraße 5, D-91058 Erlangen, Germany

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究镍基高温合金的蠕变性能，与生物医用增材制造方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical context, no porous structure, no stress shielding, no fatigue testing, no surface morphology for osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索激光选区熔化镍基高温合金的蠕变性能。
summary_zh.method: 制备试样并进行高温蠕变测试。
summary_zh.result: 该合金表现出优越的蠕变强度。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the creep performance of a nickel-based superalloy fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Specimens were prepared and subjected to high-temperature creep testing.
summary_en.result: The alloy exhibited superior creep strength compared to conventional counterparts.
summary_en.validation: High-temperature creep tests were conducted to validate the mechanical performance.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究通过LPBF制备的多孔316L不锈钢支架以达到低弹性模量，与用户关于应力屏蔽和刚度匹配的研究方向高度相关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not report fatigue performance or surface roughness/as-built morphology, which are important for long-term implant stability and osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 设计低弹性模量多孔支架以匹配骨骼、减少应力屏蔽。
summary_zh.method: 采用选区激光熔化制备316L不锈钢多孔支架。
summary_zh.result: 实现了与骨骼接近的低弹性模量和良好力学性能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过压缩力学测试和微观结构表征验证。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a porous metallic scaffold with low elastic modulus to mitigate stress shielding in orthopedic implants.
summary_en.method: Porous 316L stainless steel scaffolds with controlled porosity were fabricated using selective laser melting.
summary_en.result: The scaffolds achieved elastic moduli comparable to human bone while maintaining sufficient mechanical strength.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical compression tests and microstructural analysis confirmed the target properties.
